Common starting questions

Do I need to know which program is right for me?

No. You can start by describing your general goals and questions to Kamilla. Official agencies determine eligibility.

Can I speak in Russian or Uzbek?

Yes. Kamilla speaks English, Russian, and Uzbek. Mention your preferred language when you get in touch.

What should I include in my first message?

Your name, preferred contact method, preferred language, and a brief description of what you need. Please avoid sending medical records, Social Security numbers, or Medicaid details by ordinary email.

How do I arrange an appointment?

Call 929-355-2787 or email kamillaturob@gmail.com to request a time. An appointment is confirmed only after you hear back.
